_comment: Every NOMAD app that should open under PUBLIC_URL/<path>/ instead of host:port.
service: NOMAD's service_name. path: where it lives. strip: true when the app has no
sub-path setting of its own, so the proxy removes the prefix (only works for apps whose
pages use relative links). env / command_append: the app's own sub-path settings. They
are re-applied to NOMAD's catalogue on every start (NOMAD resets it when it boots), and
an installed app missing them is reinstalled; its data lives in /data and survives.
${PUBLIC_URL} is expanded. extra_routes: further paths into the same app, by the
container port NOMAD publishes. Ports are always read from NOMAD, never hard-coded here.
IT Tools is not listed: it hard-codes /assets/ and cannot run under a sub-path.
